kamloops.title: Okanagan communities rally around Bald Range wildfire evacuees
kamloops.description: For many evacuees, the immediate challenge was finding somewhere to sleep, something to eat and the basic necessities they had suddenly left behind.

kamloops.title: All evacuation orders downgraded for Quilpituk Creek wildfire, residents return home
kamloops.description: All residents who were forced out of their homes due to the Quilpituk Creek wildfire, burning north of West Kelowna, were allowed to go home on Friday.

kamloops.title: Conservative candidate says he’s heard Poilievre criticism from voters
kamloops.description: The comments came during an all-candidates panel for the Aug. 31 byelection in North Vancouver—Capilano, where the Conservatives are hoping to flip a seat from the Liberals.

kamloops.title: Homes across B.C. have been decimated by wildfires. Here's what to know about your insurance
kamloops.description: Hundreds of structures have been lost to wildfires so far this year.  Experts say even those who are fully insured will face a long, complex process as they begin to rebuild.

kamloops.title: Canadair water-bomber builder feels heat of demand as wildfires rage around the world
kamloops.description: As Canada, the United States and Europe grapple with another brutal wildfire season, pressure is building on the manufacturer of the Canadair "Super Scooper" water bombers to increase production, and on the federal government to bulk order the planes.

southeast.title: Health minister to take finance portfolio, jobs minister moving to health in B.C. cabinet shuffle
southeast.description: B.C. Premier David Eby announced the temporary change to his cabinet on Friday, a day after Finance Minister Brenda Bailey revealed she had early-stage, treatable cancer.

all.title: More B.C. evacuees returning home Saturday, but told to prepare for changes
all.description: Residents are advised to take precautions when they return home, including sanitizing their fridges as they clear out spoiled food, and to assess trees and property for damages.

all.title: Peachland residents to return home Friday, 1 week after Bald Range fire started
all.description: As of 6 p.m. on Aug. 14, evacuation orders for all properties in Peachland and Electoral Area West will be downgraded to evacuation alerts, officials say.

all.title: Fort St. John mayor calls for gang task force support after surge in targeted shootings
all.description: Fort St. John Mayor Lilia Hansen wants B.C.'s gang task force to intervene after three shootings in less than a month near local schools.

all.title: Tree planting started as a summer job, but it also taught me what it means to be Canadian
all.description: Jackson Bonn reflects on his many seasons of work in the Canadian bush and why he can't step away from this back-breaking work.

all.title: 2 men charged in relation to 2025 gang-related killing in Langley
all.description: The charges stem from a shooting in September 2025 when 24-year-old Taran Pandher was attacked while riding in a taxi as a passenger.

all.title: Hockey Night in Canada: Punjabi Edition not returning after 18 years
all.description: Hockey Night in Canada: Punjabi Edition has been cancelled after 18 years on the air, the show announced Friday.
